title: Count Zero Request Servers
summary: Given an integer n for the total number of servers, a 2D array logs for server requests, and an integer x with a queries array, return an array arr where each arr[i] is the count of servers that did not receive any requests in the interval [queries[i] - x, queries[i]].
statement: Given an integer n for the total number of servers, a 2D array logs for server requests, and an integer x with a queries array, return an array arr where each arr[i] is the count of servers that did not receive any requests in the interval [queries[i] - x, queries[i]].
constraints: Servers are numbered 1 through n; log [server,time] records a request.
For each query q, its active window is the inclusive interval [q-x,q].
Return how many servers have no request in each query window, preserving query order.
hints: Sort logs and queries by time.
Maintain counts per server for logs in the current inclusive window.
Advance the right pointer through time q and remove logs strictly before q-x; answer n minus active keys.
The two pointers maintain exactly the query interval, while per-server counts handle multiple logs without double counting.
editorial: The two pointers maintain exactly the query interval, while per-server counts handle multiple logs without double counting.

tests.explanation: At time ten only server one is active; at eleven only server two is active, giving one and two idle servers.
With a zero-width window server one is active only for query one.
